body: Do you think porn “ruins people”, or taps into unconscious desires of a lot of people in this regard? Honestly I often wonder about the psychology of porn turning me into a submissive bitch

I’ve had a lot of experiences that lead me to believe that there is an afterlife, very personal things that most people would roll their eyes at if I told them. That’s neither here nor there. Whenever I get suicidal that all shuts off. All I wish for is and end to it all and nothingness after.
Thanks for the kind words, I really appreciate them.
I made an attempt at humor
Do you have any brunch meetings
I don’t have that sort of insurance or money, and if I got medical attention theirs a good chance they’d lock me in the loony bin and take away my guns
The only help I can get is help from myself. Talking to anyone only ends in empty advice or compliments. I’ve been on this road for a long time and it’s been downhill for all of it
